notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

· Fixed incorrect 3D resolution scaling when moving game screen to a different monitor
· Fixed leaderboard jumping to score position being off by one
· Fixed leaderboard getting stuck when jumping to scores near the bottom

notes.title: A little protection from unfortunate game overs
notes.notes: Now, instead of immediately triggering game over, there is a 1 second delay along with a red tint and sound effect, which fades away if no longer in danger before the 1 second timer.
